deployments_detail.use: no confirmed named AI deployment (only 3rd-party strategy analysis; no primary announcement)

Miller Copilot collaborative welding line: partnership with AI-welding specialist Novarc Technologies to bring next-generation AI-powered, real-time adaptive welding software (computer vision + adaptive control) to Miller's cobot welding systems, addressing skilled-labor shortages and part-to-part / fit-up variation. [Novarc Technologies (Miller Electric / ITW Welding)]

Miller Insight Centerpoint: real-time weld-cell feedback system that monitors every parameter of every weld, alerts welders when a weld is missed or falls outside acceptable parameters, verifies proper weld sequences, and provides early defect containment/control on manufacturing lines. [Miller Electric (ITW Welding)]

Miller Insight Core: cloud-based weld data management solution deployed to monitor and report welding productivity (arc-on time, machine/welder analysis) with the goal of improving productivity and quality across manufacturing operations. [Miller Electric (ITW Welding)]

Miller Insight ArcAgent: weld data acquisition and analytics technology that gathers weld data from any power source (including mixed/non-Miller fleets) for productivity and quality improvement, over/under-weld elimination, missing/incomplete weld detection, and process monitoring/alarming. [Miller Electric / Impact Engineering (ITW Welding)]

AI/ML in Instron materials-testing systems: per Instron product management, AI is being built into testing to identify trends/patterns to catch quality issues faster and reduce shipping bad product, plus voice commands and virtual assistants to simplify machine operation; safety coaching built into latest 3400/6800 Series universal testing systems. [Instron (ITW Test & Measurement)]

Hobart NGW (Next Generation Wrapper) automatic meat/produce wrapping system: advanced machine-vision system with camera and sensor technology that automatically sizes and weighs each package and optimizes film efficiency via variable film usage. [Hobart (ITW Food Equipment Group)]

Miller AugmentedArc augmented-reality welding training system: deployed multiprocess (MIG/TIG/Stick/Flux-Cored) AR simulation with realistic torch/helmet interfaces, real-time feedback on maintaining welding parameters, instructor LMS, and performance analytics to accelerate welder skill-building. [Miller Electric (ITW Welding)]

Corporate Strategic Sourcing uses JAGGAER's AI-powered sourcing optimization platform for complex multi-round bid analysis, multi-component cost breakdown, and consolidating buying power across ITW's business segments. [JAGGAER]
deployments_detail.value: Over $500M annual spend managed; ~5% savings on direct materials and up to 45% on indirect (e.g. $220K saved on a $5M lubricant buy; $63K saved on $140K heating elements)
